title: Cops’ spouses, partners urged to report cases of abuse; PNP vows probe

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police (PNP) urged spouses and partners of police personnel to report incidents of physical and psychological abuse, assuring them that the complaints will be investigated and acted upon. “Do not allow fear or the position of your partner in the organization to silence you,” said PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez
